title: Microsoft Purview: DLP for network traffic through Entra Global Secure Access Internet Access
summary: Hold: the automation examples do not configure the protections the table promises. The PowerShell command creates a policy rather than its audit or block rules, and linking a Global Secure Access security profile requires a beta Graph property absent from the cited v1.0 API. The Purview portal path also stops before the audit or block controls.
